title: Say Subok ed Silong na Daluyon
intro: Sakey a propeta, a nabebelatan ed misyon to, so nanggawa na desisyon ya angitonton ed sikaton arawi ed totoo to tan diad ag-iilaloan a subok. Say biahe to so walaan na dramatikon pananguman, ya anubok ed pananisia tan anos to diad sankarakpan a paraan. Sarag mo kasin naamtaan iray detalye na sayan nikadkaduman ebento manlapud saray niiter a pakapatnagan?
clues: Walay sakey a propeta ya imbaki ed sakey a totoo, balet ta sikatoy tinmaynan a tampol, lapud sikatoy adismaya ed impangipulisay ed sikara.
Say biahe to so angitonton ed sikato ed dayat, a diman et linmugan ed sakey a barkon ambelat so karga to pian manaanap na dalanan.
Sinmabi so maksil a bagyo, a mamepeligro ed barko, tan nandesisyon a mangipelag na sakey a too pian onlemewan so awit, a nadetermina ed panamegley na pampapalaranan.
Sikatoy inakmon na sakey a pinalsa ed kaaralman, sakey a mamilagron ebento ya ingganggan na Madibinon linawa.
Diad loob na eges na pinalsa, sikatoy tinmawag ed Katawan to, a nagbabawi tan inggloria toy Allah diad kabilungetan.

Kayari na sakey a panaon na masimoon a pikakasi, sikatoy imbantak ed sakey ya ag-ontutubo a gilig na dayat, makapuy balet ta mabilay, tan diad saginonor et pinmawil tan aromog ton anisia la ray totoo to.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say biahe ed eges na baleg a sira
Say manpopoolan a kiew a panangiparungtal
trial.answer: Say biahe ed eges na baleg a sira

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Sakey a balon sipanan ed katooan
Sakey a mamilagron inkianak parad totoo to
Sakey a panarian ya inletneg parad poli to
Say ipawil tod saray totoo to ya anisia nen saman
Sakey a pananalo ed sakey a mapangtan manuley
outcome.answer: Say ipawil tod saray totoo to ya anisia nen saman

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
